evidence: Surface morphology was studied using a high resolution Leo 1550 field-emission gun scanning electron microscope (SEM). The content of residual iodine was determined by X-ray photoelectron spectrometry (XPS). Crystallinity of the films was evaluated using a Philips MPD 1880 powder X-ray diffractometer (XRD). Dielectric properties were measured using an MDC 818 three-function mercury probe. The method developed by Ylilammi and Ranta-aho was used to calculate the film thickness and growth rate from the optical transmission spectra measured with a Hitachi U2000 spectrophotometer. Capacitance-voltage (C-V) and dispersion curves were recorded using an HP 4284A precision LCR meter.
